::: {#rem-kolmogorov-fixed-computer}
#### Why the choice of computer hardly matters

Applying @thm-kolmogorov-invariance with the roles of $U$ and $A$ swapped
gives a constant $c'_A$ with $\kolm_A\paren{x} \le \kolm_U\paren{x} + c'_A$.
Together, $\abs{\kolm_U\paren{x} - \kolm_A\paren{x}} \le \max(c_A, c'_A)$ for every $x$,
and in the same way
$\abs{\kolm_U\paren{x \mid n} - \kolm_A\paren{x \mid n}} \le \max(c_A, c'_A)$ for every $x$ and $n$.
The constant can be large, so the complexity of one short string means little,
but statements about how $\kolmf{x}$ grows with the length of $x$
do not depend on the computer.
From here on, $U$ is fixed and dropped from the notation.

:::
